department: UCD School of Biomolecular and Biomedical Science

deadline.value: Funded PhD positions are advertised each May or June for the following September; no closing date is given.
deadline.quote: These are advertised on the 'Research Vacancies' page on the SBBS website on an annual basis in May/June for entry in the following September.

gre_subject.value: There is no Biomedical Science GRE Subject test, and the pages checked do not mention GRE.

supervisor.value: Applicants outside the funded posts are advised to contact a potential supervisor first.
supervisor.quote: candidates interested in pursuing a PhD programme within the School should initially make contact with a potential supervisor in a chosen research area

funding.value: The School offers only a small number of funded PhD positions.
funding.quote: SBBS offers a small number of funded PhD positions.

entry_route.value: A second-class honours degree in the relevant subject is the stated minimum; no master's is mentioned.
entry_route.quote: you will be expected to have a minimum of a second class honours degree in in the relevant subject area

notes: The entry-criteria page points applicants to UCD's English rule, so no School-specific English value is recorded. Funded places are limited, and the page gives no closing date.
